name: Abandoned Cart Flow (4 Emails + 1 SMS)
purpose: Push them over the edge. They're already interested: remind them, add proof, then a mystery discount they can't resist.

source.note: Fluid flow system v2, distilled from 31 client strategies (fluid-flow-strategist skill). Fluid's docs call this Abandoned Checkout; it triggers on Started Checkout and shows the cart in a dynamic table.

profileFilter.description: Placed Order zero times since starting this flow

subject: I think you forgot this…
actions.name: Email #1: Simple Reminder
actions.structure: Headline → Sub headline → Button → Dynamic Table → Button

actions.job: Simple reminder about the items in their cart
actions.body: You left something in your cart at {{brand.name}}. Finish checking out: {{event.extra.checkout_url}}

actions.job: Reviews for what's in the cart, plus the attach item
subject: Here's what people are saying about {{brand.name}}
actions.name: Email #2: Reminder + Social Proof
actions.topic: Here's what people are saying about {{brand.name}}

all: Bundle or attach item (DATA: what's most often bought with it)
replenishable: Reviews for what's in the cart
one_off: Reviews about quality, fit and service
Expert help before they complete the order

actions.job: Excitement and urgency: a mystery discount revealed at checkout
subject: Grab your MYSTERY Discount
actions.name: Email #3: Mystery Discount
actions.offer: Teaser above the real value: "Get up to 30% off", real 15% (20% when W is 15%+). Code MYSTERY

all: "Get up to {{offers.mystery_teaser}} off"; the code reveals the real value at checkout

actions.job: The mystery code expires at midnight
subject: Last chance for your mystery discount
actions.name: Email #4: Mystery Discount (last chance)
actions.topic: Last chance for your mystery discount
actions.offer: Same mystery code, expires at midnight
